L2t: The Arab Creativity Union is an Egypt-based organization that promotes creative work across the Arab world and has held its Arab Creativity Oscar awards under patronage from Arab League officials.
L3t: The Arab League Secretary General who held office from 2001 to 2011, an Egyptian former foreign minister, is the one who sponsored the Arab Creativity Union's first Arab Creativity Oscar.
L4t: The first Arab Creativity Oscar for the Arab Creativity Union was sponsored by Amr Mousa, the Arab League Secretary General.
L2f: The Arab Creativity Union is a Tunis-based body that was founded by the Arab League itself and has awarded its Creativity Oscar mainly to film directors since the 1960s.
L3f: The first Arab Creativity Oscar took place after 2016, under the Arab League Secretary General who is a former Egyptian foreign minister and took office that year.
L4f: The Arab League Secretary General who sponsored the first Arab Creativity Oscar for the Arab Creativity Union was Ahmed Aboul Gheit.
